text: I have been going to Chamchant clinic for past 10 years.from Australia. The  service is excellent and Doctors are very efficient. Fees are so cheap. Speak English. I recommend anyone.
Kind and attentive service with good price. Recommend to make an appointment here ahead of time before coming (or come here first time just to make an appointment first if the line is too long).
Used this clinic for more than 40 years
The appointment was not kept and we had to wait for an hour. We should arrange a new time.
The doctors and nurses provide excellent and professional service at reasonable prices. Highly recommended! They might be busy, so it's best to call and make an appointment in advance.

Yesterday I had a molar extracted. It was difficult to remove because the root was crooked, but I insisted that the doctor do it. The doctor was very gentle, constantly asking and explaining things, showing consideration for the patient. The service was excellent, from the receptionist to the kind doctor. Thank you.

Here, dental X-rays are not used for diagnosis. For root canal treatment and fillings, six teeth were filled. Two needed re-fillings around the same time, and one recently filled tooth had to be re-examined at another dental clinic because the problem hadn't been addressed. Two clinics concluded that all three teeth required root canal treatment and new crowns. I wasted tens of thousands of baht on fillings, not including the numerous baht spent on X-rays.
